name: Ungrateful People
overview: Scripture reveals the heartache God endures when His people become ungrateful and murmur against Him, as seen in Numbers 14:27 where He expresses His burden over the Israelites' complaints. Ungratefulness is often linked to pride, which breeds contention instead of wisdom, as Proverbs 13:10 teaches. Moreover, responding to good with evil brings ongoing trouble to one's household (Proverbs 17:13), highlighting the destructive nature of ingratitude. Yet, Isaiah 61:1 reminds us of the Lord’s anointing to bring healing and freedom, encouraging a heart that recognizes and proclaims God's goodness rather than rejecting it.
